## Summary

Minimal Rust Cargo project scaffolding with a top-level Makefile that defaults to `help` and has a `references` target cloning Apache Lucene. The `.gitignore` ignores the `references/` directory. Root `Cargo.toml` is single-crate with `[workspace]` placeholder for future sub-crates.
